results: Seven-week curriculum contract, progression, choices, objective keys, and culminating source packets are complete
Frozen Reading baseline student and parent definitions retain their verified hashes
All seven saves and repeated portal sync preserve the submitted baseline byte-for-byte and touch only Reading-owned records
Student export excludes the baseline and parent review; parent backup includes seven module records and the saved rubric
Validated restore recreates missing Reading work, keeps the surviving baseline untouched, and gives current local responses priority
Restore keeps topic, completion, objective result, and latest completed checkpoint coherent
Parent reviews require a completed checkpoint, retain immutable evidence, and reject stale forms after a newer checkpoint
Imported Reading work rejects wrong response types, unknown options, incomplete or cross-topic checkpoints, bad results, skills, assistance, and checks
Checkpoint mutation, conflicting completed topics, and reviews pointing to missing checkpoints reject atomically
Unknown modules reject before mutation and a failed multi-key restore rolls back earlier writes
Malformed Reading work stops safely without overwriting its raw recovery record
Portal decorators use stable assignment IDs and both student and parent Reading integrations are loaded
